Class ShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.gameClasses.ShipBoard
Direct Known Subclasses:
LevelOneShipBoard, LevelTwoShipBoard
public class ShipBoard extends Object
This class is used to describe all information associated to the shipboard of a player
